description: Read: can apartments, vehicles and Operatives be resold on the Marketplace? Reads the Marketplace's switches live and says exactly what blocks apartments and vehicles (the Marketplace only lists collections its owner switched on, and these two are not) and what would change it. Operatives resell with prepare_list_nft. Also says what a plain wallet to wallet transfer can and cannot do. Read only.
name: asset_resale_info
